title: The Baler and the Little Hay Bricks
synopsis: A baler gathers dry windrows into small rectangular hay bales while Gus imagines building a house for a giant sheep.
continuity_state: Before: The hayfield was raked into windrows. Farmer Ruth is still checking drying conditions and has not made bales. After: On a later suitable dry day grown-ups have used a tractor-drawn small-square baler to form tied rectangular hay bales. Bales remain in the field awaiting collection; the empty hay wagon is still by the barn.
